name: Image Model / SD3 explorer
description: A model for experimenting with all the SD3 settings

action.description: A model for experimenting with all the SD3 settings
action.name: fofr/sd3-explorer

guidance_scale.description: The guidance scale tells the model how similar the output should be to the prompt.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

model.description: Pick whether to use T5-XXL in fp16, fp8 or not at all
model.title: Model

negative_conditioning_end.description: When the negative conditioning should stop being applied. By default it is disabled.
negative_conditioning_end.title: Negative Conditioning End

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompts do not really work in SD3. This will simply cause your output image to vary in unpredictable ways.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

number_of_images.description: The number of images to generate
number_of_images.title: Number Of Images

output_quality.description: Quality of the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality.
output_quality.title: Output Quality

prompt.description: This prompt is ignored when using the triple prompt mode. See below.
prompt.title: Prompt

sampler.description: The sampler to use for the diffusion model
sampler.title: Sampler

scheduler.description: The scheduler to use for the diffusion model
scheduler.title: Scheduler

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

shift.description: The timestep scheduling shift. Try values 6.0 and 2.0 to experiment with effects.
shift.title: Shift

steps.description: The number of steps to run the diffusion model for
steps.title: Steps

triple_prompt_clip_g.description: The prompt that will be passed to just the CLIP-G model.
triple_prompt_clip_g.title: Triple Prompt Clip G

triple_prompt_clip_l.description: The prompt that will be passed to just the CLIP-L model.
triple_prompt_clip_l.title: Triple Prompt Clip L

triple_prompt_empty_padding.description: Whether to add padding for empty prompts. Useful if you only want to pass a prompt to one or two of the three text encoders. Has no effect when all prompts are filled. Disable this for interesting effects.
triple_prompt_empty_padding.title: Triple Prompt Empty Padding

triple_prompt_t5.description: The prompt that will be passed to just the T5-XXL model.
triple_prompt_t5.title: Triple Prompt T5
